# ECN-2026-037 - Change notice - Machining radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01

Reason for change
- Field verification identified inconsistent mandrel clamp preload procedures on EQ-P2-L3-RR01 during routine maintenance. To standardize bolting practice and reduce risk of clamp slippage and part runout, the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification is being formalized in machine documentation and operator procedures.
- Change aligns maintenance and machining practices with existing SOPs and reduces rework from inconsistent clamp torque.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01 (Machining radial ring rolling mill #1).
- Documentation updates: SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-02, SOP-P2-L3-04 will be revised where mandrel clamp torque or clamp procedure is referenced to reflect the approved torque value.
- Work instructions and maintenance checklists associated with P2-L3 will be updated to include the torque callout.

Implementation
- Mandrel clamp bolt torque for Machining radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L3-RR01) is 470 N·m. This value is to be used for all torque application steps when securing the mandrel clamp.
- Update actions:
  - Amend SOP-P2-L3-01 to include the torque requirement in the machine setup procedure.
  - Amend SOP-P2-L3-02 to include torque verification in the shift changeover checklist.
  - Amend SOP-P2-L3-04 to include torque verification in preventive maintenance steps.
- Training: Operators and maintenance personnel who perform mandrel clamp tasks on EQ-P2-L3-RR01 will receive a brief instruction on the revised procedure and the torque verification step.
- Verification: During the first scheduled maintenance after implementation, torque readings for the mandrel clamp bolts will be recorded in the equipment maintenance log.

Approvals
- Engineering sign-off required prior to SOP revisions.
- Maintenance supervision approval required to schedule training and verification.
- Document control will release revised SOP-P2-L3-01, SOP-P2-L3-02, SOP-P2-L3-04 after approvals.
